title: fix(plugins): preserve live ClawHub package metadata
body:
Related: #148074

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves two live ClawHub validation defects left after the Docker fixture was isolated:

1. Live-mode plugin sweeps inherited the synthetic fixture package, so the public lane did not exercise the published `@openclaw/kitchen-sink` plugin.
2. The public artifact resolver returned npm-pack `size` metadata, but the top-level adapter dropped it. Installation succeeded, then lifecycle validation rejected the incomplete install record.

#148129 separately landed the stale Docker helper assertion repair. That assertion is preserved on `main` and is not part of this PR's remaining diff.

## Why This Change Was Made

The ClawHub sweep now selects its default package after choosing live or fixture mode, while explicit package and runtime-ID overrides still win. Executable coverage verifies fixture default, live default, and explicit override routing.

The live artifact adapter now carries the registry-owned `size` fact into the existing metadata normalizer. Missing or malformed sizes remain optional; no downstream recomputation or fallback was added.

The weaker static fixture-literal assertion is removed because the executable routing matrix now protects the actual behavior.

## User Impact

Full release validation now exercises the published ClawHub plugin in live mode. ClawHub npm-pack installs also retain the advertised artifact size in their canonical install metadata.

## Evidence

Retained live proof head: `9ce5c455e0e37ec8962575bbfe02ed7e43fc0f7e`.

- Sanitized AWS Crabbox run: `run_0644d3db144a`
  - Public network, no hydration, no instance role, no ClawHub credentials.
  - Run: https://crabbox.openclaw.ai/portal/runs/run_0644d3db144a
- Focused regression: 1 passed, 91 skipped.
- Routing matrix: 3 passed, covering fixture default, live default, and explicit overrides.
- ClawHub fixture server: 7 passed.
- `check-changed`: passed for all five remaining files.
- Public artifact contract: `kind=npm-pack`, `size=985548`.
- Fixture Docker lifecycle: `Using ClawHub package @openclaw/plugin-e2e-fixture (code-plugin).` then `OK`.
- Live Docker lifecycle: `Using ClawHub package @openclaw/kitchen-sink (code-plugin).` then `OK`.
- Before the metadata repair, the live lifecycle installed the official package and failed because `clawpackSize` was absent.
- Fresh P0-P2 autoreview of the reconciled five-file diff: no actionable findings.
- At the retained proof revision, the `main` merge check was mergeable with no touched-file conflict.

Diff classification: production `+2`, E2E tooling `+4`, tests `+65`, docs `+1`. `CHANGELOG.md` is release-owned; no release-note file was changed.


## Maintainer regression proof

Repeated against the production delta at `b901d0625f3a279ff9c12b357c8a2a988eadd20b` in a scratch copy. Only the two production hunks were reversed and restored; the regression assertions were retained. For the lifecycle boundary, the existing synthetic resolver/archive fixture supplied the installer result to `buildClawHubPluginInstallRecordFields`, the existing SQLite E2E writer, and the unmodified `assertions.mjs clawhub-installed` entry point. This is synthetic boundary proof, not a new live-network or published-driver upgrade run.

Commands, run from the scratch copy:

```sh
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/clawhub.test.ts -t 'accepts the live ClawHub artifact resolver shape'
node .local/lifecycle-proof.mjs
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/package-compat.test.ts -t 'selects the ClawHub identity'
```

Before restoring the production hunks:

```text
Metadata regression: expected undefined to be 4096
Tests: 1 failed | 91 skipped
installer: ok=true; install record clawpackSize=undefined
lifecycle validator exit=1
Error: missing ClawHub ClawPack metadata for demo

Live default routing:
Expected: "clawhub:@openclaw/kitchen-sink"
Received: "clawhub:@openclaw/plugin-e2e-fixture"
Tests: 1 failed | 2 passed | 23 skipped
```

After restoring the production hunks:

```text
Metadata regression: 1 passed | 91 skipped
installer: ok=true; install record clawpackSize=4096
lifecycle validator exit=0
clawhub-installed: PASS
Routing: 3 passed | 23 skipped (fixture default, live default, explicit override)
```

## ClawSweeper review

The review of `b901d0625f3a279ff9c12b357c8a2a988eadd20b` found no actionable findings. No items required applying or skipping.

## Documentation and CI handoff

Commit `987100cb3937807a242bf486524d2f48f24d9322` adds one line documenting `OPENCLAW_PLUGINS_E2E_LIVE_CLAWHUB=1` beside the existing plugin E2E environment flags. The production patch and contributor commit ancestry are unchanged. `node scripts/check-changed.mjs -- docs/help/testing/docker.md` and independent P0–P2 review passed.

The authorized single rerun of CI `34852596312` on `b901d0625f3a279ff9c12b357c8a2a988eadd20b` failed again in [checks-node-compact-large-24](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34852596312/job/104015228878), attempt 2:

```text
src/wizard/setup.inference-recovery.integration.test.ts:274
Expected: "promotion refused"
Received: "Shared-state admission requires the host broker"
```

This file is unchanged by the PR. Main now contains the wizard database-fork routing repair at `6fd4d0d52a9f161f3eaaf6b2ca473101315069b3`. Refreshed PR head `fe7326f32d443c73089bcf6d69e260e55de403a9` preserves the production patch and documentation addition; its GitHub merge ref includes that main fix. [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34869505739) is running. No assertion, timeout, or retry policy was changed in this PR.


Thanks @onlyysaurabh for the original contribution and @vincentkoc for the live-mode and metadata repairs.
